messages:
marta: Quick sync — we're finalizing stopping rules for the reranker A/B next week. Primary metric = CTR@3, secondary = latency p95. Need: early-stop thresholds, minimum sample per arm, and rollback criteria. Can owners chime in? @devin @alexa

devin: For metrics: CTR@3 is fine. Suggest stop-if-no-effect: delta <= 0.1% for 48h after >=20k users per arm. Also add a harm threshold: latency p95 increase > 30ms -> immediate rollback.

alexa: flag name will be rollout.toggle.reranker.v4 (bool) + audience percent. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 3 phases. I'll author the flag + experiment config in infra. Example config snippet: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_flag" "reranker_v4" {
  key = "rollout.toggle.reranker.v4"
  default = false
  rollout = { phases = [{pct = 5, duration = "24h"}, {pct = 25, duration = "24h"}, {pct = 50, duration = "24h"}] }
}
```

sahil: min sample per arm should be at least 10k for primary metric power; if we see <10k in phase, extend that phase. Recommend Bayesian stopping with ROPE +/-0.5% on CTR for clearer futility signals.

jin: small ask — restrict phase 1 canary to regions: US-east & EU-west only. helps capacity and regional monitoring.

marta: OK consolidating into concrete rules: 
- Success stop: posterior P(delta > 0) >= 0.95 AND >=10k users/arm
- Futility stop: posterior P(|delta| < 0.5%) >= 0.95 AND >=20k users/arm
- Safety rollback: latency p95 increase > 30ms OR error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute -> immediate rollback
- Minimum phase duration: 24h
These are starting points; we can iterate after first canary.

alexa: I'll add the experiment config + flag in the infra repo and open a PR. tagging @katie_pt for infra review.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-rollout job scheduled by @alexa, job_id=deploy-9921, eta=Mon 09:00 UTC.

katie_pt: happy to review infra PR later today, please @mention the exact repo path.

devin: please add tracing hooks and a small sample-logging toggle for failed reranker queries. Also create dashboard alerts: 
- CTR@3 drift >= 0.4% over 1h -> notify
- latency p95 +20ms sustained over 10m -> page on-call

marta: I'll author the runbook section and link the eval prompt set. Can someone add the QoS guardrail entry in Console (SLA watchlist) before we kick off? @sahil

sahil: on it — will add entries and conditional alerts after lunch.

marta: Closing notes: if no blockers, alexa to open PR and schedule canary for Monday 09:00 UTC. Flag rollout phases + regional filter in phase 1. Keep comms here for any last-minute stops. :thumbsup:
